a.lede: Microsoft has released out-of-band (OOB) Windows updates to remove trust in certificates tied to compromised eMudhra certificate authority keys, protecting systems that do not receive automatic certificate trust updates. [...]
a.title: Microsoft releases Windows OOB updates to distrust eMudhra certificates

b.lede: Did you hear the one about eMudhra and the power of 4? Time to get connected to certificate trust list updates
b.title: Microsoft releases out-of-band Windows fixes with certificate updates
